About Cards

Cards strips the matching genre down to its essence: colours and numbers only, no action cards, no stacking, no betting. Each turn you either play a matching card or draw one and pass.

When the deck runs out the discard pile is reshuffled automatically, so a match never stalls. Most games finish in two or three minutes.

How to play

  1. Each player is dealt seven cards and one card is flipped to start.
  2. Play a card matching the top card's colour or number; otherwise draw one and end your turn.
  3. First to empty their hand wins; the discard pile is reshuffled when the deck runs out.

Frequently asked questions

Are there action cards or stacking?
No. This version deliberately keeps only colour and number matching for shorter, faster games.
What happens when the deck runs out?
The discard pile is reshuffled automatically, so play continues.
Can I play a friend online?
Yes — create a room and share the invite link.
